kaikki_vikisozluk.e: هَجَا • (hajā) I (non-past يَهْجُو (yahjū), verbal noun هَجْو (hajw) or هِجَاء (hijāʔ))
g: to speak poorly of, to satirize, to dispraise or revile with words, to lampoon
to pronounce or speak of something's various traits or flaws
to pronounce syllables, to spell out, to annunciate or make plain the various sounds of a word

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: هَجَّى • (hajjā) II (non-past يُهَجِّي (yuhajjī), verbal noun تَهْجِيَة (tahjiya))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Morphologically from the root ه ج و (h j w).

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: تَهَجَّى • (tahajjā) V (non-past يَتَهَجَّى (yatahajjā), verbal noun تَهَجٍّ (tahajjin))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Morphologically from the root ه ج و (h j w).

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: هَجْوِيّ • (hajwiyy) (feminine هَجْوِيَّة (hajwiyya), masculine plural هَجْوِيُّون (hajwiyyūn), feminine plural هَجْوِيَّات (hajwiyyāt))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t:
Etymology tree
Arabic هَجْو (hajw)
Proto-Afroasiatic
Proto-Semitic
Arabic ـِيّ (-iyy)
Arabic هجوي
From هَجْو (hajw, “ridiculing”) + ـِيّ (-iyy).
